name: Luana Andrade
bio: Grew up in her father's rehearsal room. Can tell a Rio pressing from a Bogotá one by the hiss.

notes.note: Cumbia, bossa, and things that move at the speed of a Sunday. Play it loud enough that the neighbours ask.
Home. São Paulo is concrete and rain and somebody’s speaker on a balcony; this is what is usually coming out of it.
The Rio pressings and the Bogotá ones side by side. You can tell them apart by the hiss, and now so can you.
Buenos Aires is a three-hour flight and a completely different Sunday. Mateo Molinari first, always.
Santiago has the Andes at the end of every street, and bands that play like they know it. Start with I.A.R.
